race.title: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Fillies' Handicap
race.verdict: RIBENSKA 's best efforts have come on all-weather and with this return to 7f sure to be in her favour, Charlie Fellowes' 4-y-o gets the tentative nod to double her tally from a sliding mark at the expense of Enola Grey , who looked unlucky not to finish closer at Wolverhampton recently. Course winner Spirit of Jenny rounds off the shortlist. RIBENSKA (IRE) ENOLA GREY (IRE) SPIRIT OF JENNY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Enola Grey (7/2), Lady Mariko (9/2), Diamondinthedark (11/2), Forbidden Colours (11/2), Ribenska (8/1), Mountain Of Light (10/1), Spirit Of Jenny (10/1), Mayo County (10/1), Fistral Beach (16/1), Lope El Fuego (20/1)
